values: 为全体友军大幅提升急速，并使“星界牵绊”内的友军霸体。
Elijah and Lailah greatly increase all allies' Haste and make allies linked through Stellar Bond unaffected.

被动地，伊莱亚和莱拉在战斗中会各自独立行动并共享生命值与能量，且最大生命值提高50%。
主动使用时，二人会一同起舞，为全体友军提升60 + 4点急速，持续7秒。本技能持续时间内，二人还会使“星界牵绊”内的所有友军获得霸体。本技能仅当伊莱亚处于可以使用终极技能的状态下时才能使用。

Passive. Elijah and Lailah fight separately in battle but share the same HP and Energy pool. Their max HP is increased by 50%.
Active. Elijah and Lailah perform an inspiring duo dance, increasing all allies' Haste by 60 + 4 for 7s. During the dance, allies linked through Stellar Bond become unaffected. The skill can be cast as long as Elijah is able to use Ultimate.
主动使用时的效果持续时间提高至7.5秒。
When actively used, extends the duration of the Haste bonus to 7.5s.
主动使用时的效果持续时间提高至8秒。
When actively used, extends the duration of the Haste bonus to 8s.
主动使用时的效果持续时间提高至8.5秒。
When actively used, extends the duration of the Haste bonus to 8.5s.
主动使用时的效果持续时间提高至9秒。
When actively used, extends the duration of the Haste bonus to 9s.
二人沿连线向彼此发射祝福，分别为途经的友军恢复生命值与能量。
Elijah and Lailah form a straight-line link, channeling blessings that recover allies' Energy and HP along the path.

布阵时，伊莱亚和莱拉之间会形成一道“星界牵绊”。若伊莱亚和莱拉刚好在同一条直线路径上，则还会与布阵在二人中间的所有友方英雄建立“星界牵绊”。“星界牵绊”内的友军永久获得25%攻击力提升，但布阵阶段每多连接一名友军，该攻击力提升效果便会降低5%。
主动使用时，伊莱亚沿“星界牵绊”向莱拉传递一团金色光芒，为途经的每位“星界牵绊”内的友军恢复30 + 4点能量；莱拉沿“星界牵绊”向伊莱亚传递一份绿色光芒，为途经的每位“星界牵绊”内的友军恢复-100% − 10% ATK生命值。

Elijah forms a Stellar Bond with Lailah when they align on the battlefield. Allied heroes placed in a straight path between the twins are also linked by Stellar Bond. Stellar Bond grants a permanent ATK bonus to all linked allies, including Elijah and Lailah. If no other allies are linked, Elijah and Lailah gain an ATK increase of 25%. However, for each additional ally linked, this ATK bonus is reduced by 5% for everyone linked by the bond.
Active. Elijah sends a golden glow through the Stellar Bond link to Lailah, restoring 30 + 4 Energy to each linked ally along the path. Simultaneously, Lailah sends a green glow through the Stellar Bond link to Elijah, healing each linked ally along the path for an HP amount equal to -100% − 10% ATK.
伊莱亚恢复的能量值提高至35 + 4点，莱拉恢复的生命值提高至-110% − 10% ATK。
Increases the Energy recovered by Elijah's golden glow to 35 + 4, and the HP recovered through Lailah's green glow to -110% − 10% ATK.
伊莱亚恢复的能量值提高至40 + 4点，莱拉恢复的生命值提高至-120% − 10% ATK。
Increases the Energy recovered by Elijah's golden glow to 40 + 4, and the HP recovered through Lailah's green glow to -120% − 10% ATK.
伊莱亚恢复的能量值提高至45 + 4点，莱拉恢复的生命值提高至-130% − 10% ATK。
Increases the Energy recovered by Elijah's golden glow to 45 + 4, and the HP recovered through Lailah's green glow to -130% − 10% ATK.
伊莱亚为友军施加护盾，莱拉对友军身边的敌人造成伤害和致盲。
Elijah grants a shield to allies, while Lailah casts Stellar Pulse to deal damage and inflict blind on enemies surrounding her allies.

伊莱亚为莱拉和另外1名最虚弱的友军施加150% + 15% ATK护盾，持续4 + 0.4秒，并使莱拉在护盾持续期间获得霸体；
莱拉在伊莱亚和另外1名身边有敌人的友军所处位置召唤星界冲击，对1格范围内的敌人造成110% + 10% ATK伤害和持续4 + 0.4秒的致盲，并将伊莱亚身边的敌人击退1格。

Elijah grants Lailah and 1 weakest ally a 150% + 15% ATK shield that lasts for 4 + 0.4s and makes Lailah unaffected while the shield is active.
Lailah casts Stellar Pulse on the tiles occupied by Elijah and 1 ally adjacent to enemies, dealing 110% + 10% ATK damage and inflicting blind for 4 + 0.4s on enemies within 1 tile of the target tiles. Stellar Pulse also knocks back enemies surrounding Lailah by 1 tile.
伊莱亚施加的护盾值提高至160% + 15% ATK，莱拉的星界冲击伤害提高至120% + 10% ATK。
Increases the shield value granted by Elijah to 160% + 15% ATK. Increases Lailah's Stellar Pulse damage to 120% + 10% ATK.
伊莱亚施加的护盾值提高至170% + 15% ATK，莱拉的星界冲击伤害提高至130% + 10% ATK。
Increases the shield value granted by Elijah to 170% + 15% ATK. Increases Lailah's Stellar Pulse damage to 130% + 10% ATK.
伊莱亚施加的护盾值提高至180% + 15% ATK，莱拉的星界冲击伤害提高至140% + 10% ATK。
Increases the shield value granted by Elijah to 180% + 15% ATK. Increases Lailah's Stellar Pulse damage to 140% + 10% ATK.
提高自身急速，当自身释放终极技能后使“星界牵绊”内的友军额外提高急速。
Elijah and Lailah increase their own Haste and grant extra Haste to allies linked through Stellar Bond each time they cast Starlight Waltz.
战斗中，伊莱亚和莱拉提高9点急速。每当伊莱亚和莱拉释放终极技能，便会使“星界牵绊”内的所有友军永久提高3点急速，最多叠加3层。
Elijah and Lailah increase their Haste by 9 in battle. Each time they cast Starlight Waltz, they permanently increase the Haste of all allies linked through Stellar Bond by 3, stacking up to 3 times.
战斗中，伊莱亚和莱拉提高12点急速。每当伊莱亚和莱拉释放终极技能，便会使“星界牵绊”内的所有友军永久提高4点急速，最多叠加3层。

Elijah and Lailah increase their Haste by 12 in battle. Each time they cast Starlight Waltz, they permanently increase the Haste of all allies linked through Stellar Bond by 4, stacking up to 3 times.
战斗中，伊莱亚和莱拉提高15点急速。每当伊莱亚和莱拉释放终极技能，便会使“星界牵绊”内的所有友军永久提高5点急速，最多叠加3层。

Elijah and Lailah increase their Haste by 15 in battle. Each time they cast Starlight Waltz, they permanently increase the Haste of all allies linked through Stellar Bond by 5, stacking up to 3 times.
“星界牵绊”中的所有其他友军均来自统一阵营时，“星界牵绊”将会获得更加强大的增益效果，并可在其中友军全部释放终极技能后获得永久强化。
When all linked allies belong to the same faction, Stellar Bond becomes stronger and is permanently enhanced after all linked allies use their Ultimate.
战斗开始时，若“星界牵绊”内除伊莱亚和莱拉以外的所有友军均来自同一阵营，则会使“星界牵绊”获得“共鸣”效果。在“共鸣”效果影响下，“星界牵绊”额外提升其中友军10点受愈与10%能量获取速度，并且当“星界牵绊”中的每一名友军均释放过终极技能后，“星界牵绊”将会爆发出永久性的能量激荡来鼓舞全体友军，使场上所有友军在每次释放终极技能之后返还10%的能量消耗。

When a battle starts, if the allies (excluding Elijah and Lailah) linked through Stellar Bond all belong to the same faction, a special resonance effect is triggered. The resonance increases linked allies' Vitality by an extra 10 and their Energy gained by 10%. After all linked allies have cast their Ultimates while resonance is active, the bond unleashes a permanent energy burst, inspiring all allies and returning them 10% of their Energy cost each time they cast their Ultimate.
在“共鸣”效果影响下，“星界牵绊”提供的受愈提高至25点、能量获取速度提高至12%。
Increases the Vitality bonus to 25 and the Energy gain bonus to 12% while the Stellar Bond resonance is active.
在“共鸣”效果影响下，“星界牵绊”提供的受愈提高至40点、能量获取速度提高至14%。
Increases the Vitality bonus to 40 and the Energy gain bonus to 14% while the Stellar Bond resonance is active.
“星界牵绊”爆发出能量激荡后，全体友军在每次释放终极技能之后返还的能量消耗比例提高至15%。
After Stellar Bond unleashes an energy burst, increases the Energy returned to allies from each Ultimate cast to 15% of their Energy used.
“星界牵绊”内的友军会按照一定比例共享属性值。
Elijah and Lailah increase the stats of allies linked through Stellar Bond based on a certain percentage of the highest stats among them.
“星界牵绊”中的每一名友军获得攻击力、护甲与魔抗提升，数值为“星界牵绊”内其他友军对应属性最高者的15%。提升的部分最高不超过伊莱亚和莱拉对应属性初始值的30%，且通过本效果提升的属性不会再次参与到本效果的计算中。

Elijah and Lailah increase the ATK, Phys DEF, and Magic DEF of each ally linked through Stellar Bond. The increases for each linked ally are equal to 15% of the highest corresponding stats among other linked allies, but cannot exceed 30% of the original corresponding stats of Elijah and Lailah. These stat boosts are not included when calculating increases from this skill.
